resources.string: "Demo mode · sample information. No account or makerspace changes are made by this guide."
"Find your way around your makerspace. Open any section when you need it; you can use the app without completing a tutorial."
"Find equipment for your next project, or check your upcoming bookings. Your makerspace confirms availability and requests."
"Home brings together due loans, upcoming bookings and events. Choose a makerspace to see its information. Changing makerspaces changes the items and activity you are viewing."

"Search Inventory or choose a category.

Open an item to see its details and availability.

Add the items and quantities you need, then review and submit your request.

Staff confirm the request before handover.

In Activity, check each loan's due date.

Use its renewal action when available."

"Choose a space and an available date and time. Check the makerspace timezone, any form questions and cancellation information before confirming. View bookings from Home or Activity to check the confirmed status. If a time conflicts, refresh availability and review another time; a failed attempt is not a booking."

"Open Events, review the event and ticket choices, and complete the required questions before registering. Check the returned registration status: a waitlist or payment-pending result is different from registration. Open a registered ticket to show its current QR code. A ticket QR code does not confirm payment."

"Inbox works even when notifications are off. Open an update to fetch its current details, or mark updates as read after reviewing them. Turn on notifications only if you want device alerts. An alert is a prompt to check the app; access and details are checked again when you open it."

"Open Payments to review the actual charge, amount and currency. Continue to payment only when offered. After payment, wait for the makerspace to confirm the result; a closed payment screen is not a paid receipt. If checking is unavailable, refresh the status before trying again. Open an available receipt or document to view or share it."

"Profile contains account and security options. Save profile or communication changes explicitly. Verify email and phone through their own code steps. Review signed-in devices before signing one out, and keep recovery codes somewhere safe. Cancelling renewal keeps the current membership term; leaving a makerspace ends that membership as confirmed by the server. Leaving is separate from deleting an account. If deletion is unavailable, contact your makerspace for help."

"Use staff tools only for your authorized makerspace. Review the requester, items, quantities and status before accepting, rejecting or approving a booking. Follow the handover or return steps, including required photos, notes and kit counts. Check the final review and confirm deliberately. If only part of an action succeeds, refresh its status before continuing."

"Scan or enter a member, item or ticket code to find its current record. Review the resolved person, item or registration before confirming a check-in, issue or return. Scanning alone never confirms an action. If the camera is unavailable or permission is denied, use the available manual entry."

"Notifications are optional; Inbox remains available without them. Camera access is requested when you choose Scan or Take photo. Attach a photo through the system photo picker when offered; broad photo-library access is not needed. If permission is denied, use manual entry or the photo picker where available, or change permission in system Settings. You can browse inventory without these permissions."

"Options depend on your membership, the makerspace setup and the current server response. An unavailable action has not been completed. Read its message, keep your draft where offered, and use the visible retry after any waiting period. This guide does not grant access or change any account, booking, payment or stock."
"Tips reset for this account and makerspace."
